channel.title: The Escape Plan: travel alerts
channel.description: Travel advisory changes and entry-rule updates for every country.

item.title: China's visa-free trial runs through Dec 31, 2026
item.description: Many passports (including the UK and Canada since Feb 17, 2026) can visit China visa-free for up to 30 days under a trial policy that is currently set to end Dec 31, 2026. Check before booking travel for 2027. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Kazakhstan's QazETA becomes mandatory Jul 1, 2027
item.description: Visa-free visitors should get a free QazETA travel authorization at qazeta.kz at least 72 hours before arriving. It's phased in: Aktau airport and some land borders from Nov 1, 2026, Astana and Almaty airports from Jan 1, 2027, and all other entry points from Mar 1, 2027. Until Jul 1, 2027 you won't be turned away without one, but after that you can be. It's valid 180 days for multiple entries and doesn't extend your visa-free stay. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Thailand cut visa-free stays on Sep 15, 2026
item.description: Most visa-free stays dropped from 60 to 30 days, and 21 nationalities now need an e-visa. Visa-free entry is for tourism only, so remote work or business needs a proper visa such as the DTV. One 30-day extension may be granted at an immigration office at the officer's discretion. From The Escape Plan travel data. General information, not legal advice. Always check the official source before you travel.
